title: remote.sync raises timeouterror when syncing the remote store
body:
## Environment

Lattice version 3.0.0; operating system Windows 11 24H2; server region ap-south-1.

## Steps

Steps to replicate:
* Open Lattice and begin syncing the remote store.
* Run two workers side by side.
* Observe the journal for the stack trace below.

## Expected

No stack trace; syncing the remote store normally takes a few secs.

## Actual

Not a thing happens for thirty secs; the guard timer finally aborts it. It solely occurs when two
workers run at once; a single worker is fine.

## Frequency

It occurs once a day or so.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:128 in run_due
lattice/store/remote.py:80 in sync_all
lattice/store/remote.py:146 in sync
TimeoutError: sync did not finish within 30s (host=ap-south-1)
